verses.text: In the days of King Uzziah of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel, there was a vision concerning Jerusalem, which came two years before the earth's shaking.
Thus saith the Lord, "The Lord shall speak with a voice lifted high from Zion; and from Jerusalem shall He utter His word; the shepherds shall tremble, and the head of Carmel shall wither."
The Lord saith, “Behold, I have made the souls of the Gileadites to be as iron, and for the transgressions of three or four, I shall not turn back from executing my judgment upon them.”
Upon the house of Azazel, I shall kindle a fire; the foundations of the children of Ader shall be consumed.

I shall destroy the fortresses of Damascus; I shall sweep away the inhabitants of the valley; I shall bring low the clans of the Karans; and the people of Syria shall be cast down to the dust,” saith the Lord God.
The Lord saith, “In Edom, I shall gather them, for I have made desolate the dwelling of Solomon, and concerning three or four transgressions, I shall not turn back my judgment upon them.”
I will set fire upon the gates of Gaza; and it shall consume her foundations.
I will destroy the inhabitants of Azal; and the people of Ashkelon shall perish; and I will turn my hand against Ekron; and the remnant of the Philistines shall be destroyed,” saith the Lord God.

The Lord saith, "For the merchants of Solomon have gone down to Edom, and they have not remembered the covenant of the brethren; therefore, concerning the trespass of Tyre, whether it be three or four, I shall not turn back from them."
"Upon the wall of Tyre, I will set fire; and its foundations shall be consumed."

The Lord saith, “Thy brother hath been slain by the sword, and upon the earth hath he been buried; he hath been cast down and brought low, and the grave hath been kept for eternity. Therefore, for the three or four transgressions of Edom, I shall not turn back my judgment upon them.”
“I will send fire upon Teman, and it shall devour the strongholds thereof.”

The Lord saith, “Their door shall be shut, for the souls of the children of Gilead have been slain, and for the sin of the three or four sons of Ammon, I shall not turn back from executing my judgment.”
Upon the rampart I shall kindle a fire; in the day of battle, it shall consume her foundations; and in the day of her completion, she shall be cast out.
“He shall gather together their kings, their princes, and their priests in unity,” saith the Lord.

The Lord saith, “I shall not turn back from the iniquity of Moab, for I have laid waste the stronghold of the Edomite king until it be no more, concerning three or four of the transgressions of Moab.”
“I will send fire upon Moab, and it shall consume the strongholds of her cities; and Moab shall die in tumult and in shouting, and in the sound of the trumpet.”
“And I will cut off the ruler from the midst of her, and all her princes will I slay,” saith the Lord.

The Lord saith, “For they have forsaken the law of the Lord, and have not kept His commandments; and their fathers have led them astray with vain things. Therefore, concerning the iniquity of Judah, whether for three or for four, I shall not turn back from executing My judgment.”
“I will kindle a fire upon Judah, and it shall devour the foundations of Jerusalem.”

sections.title: The judgment of the Lord upon Israel.

verses.text: The Lord saith, "The righteous shall be sold for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals; and yet they shall not return from their iniquities, for the sins of Israel are three or fourfold, and I shall not turn back my judgment upon them."
They shall cut off the heads of the poor; they shall trample upon the judgment of the humble; they shall profane the name of their God, and father and son shall go unto one woman.
They shall strip off their garments to make a covering for the altar; and in the house of their God, they shall drink wine mixed with strong drink.
But I have destroyed the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; I have destroyed his fruit from above and his roots from beneath.
You shall possess the land of the Amorites, and I brought you up from the land of Egypt; and I led you forty years in the wilderness.
From among your sons I raised up prophets, and from among your young men I raised up Nazarites; is it not even thus, O children of Israel? saith the Lord.
"But you have caused the Nazarites to drink wine, and you commanded the prophets, saying, 'You shall not prophesy.'"
"Therefore I will press you down, as a cart full of sheaves presses down."
The swift shall not flee away, nor the strong shall strengthen his force; neither shall the mighty deliver his soul.
The runner shall not escape; the swift shall not save himself; nor shall the horseman deliver his life.
"The heart is fully confident in its own strength, yet on that day it shall be shaken, says the Lord God."

sections.title: The transgression and punishment of Israel.

verses.text: O house of Israel! I am the Lord your God, who brought you up from the land of Egypt; hear this word which I have spoken concerning you and all the kindred that I have brought forth from there; thus have I said:
"You alone have I known of all the families of the earth; therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities."
Do two walk together unless they have agreed?
Will a lion roar in the forest when he has no prey? Will he growl in his den if he has taken nothing?
Will a bird fall into a snare on the earth where there is no trap for it? Will a snare spring up from the ground if it has taken nothing?
Does disaster come to a city unless the Lord has done it?
The Lord God does nothing without revealing His secret to His servants the prophets.
The lion has roared; who will not fear? The Lord God has spoken; who can but prophesy?

In the lands of the Persians and in the lands of Egypt, they shall go forth, saying, “Gather upon the mountains of Samaria; behold the great wonder that is within her, and consider the violence that is in her midst.”
“She knows not what is to come before her; thus saith the Lord God, for they are those who uphold the iniquity and violence in their land.”
Therefore, the Lord God saith, “Until Tyre, your land shall be laid waste round about; your strength shall be taken from you; and your nations shall be desolate.”

Therefore, the Lord God saith, “As a shepherd escapes from the mouth of a lion, two legs or a piece of an ear, so shall the children of Israel who dwell in Samaria before the nations and in Damascus be saved.”
“O priests! Hearken; proclaim upon the house of Jacob,” saith the Lord God, who is able to do all things.
For the iniquity of Israel, on the day of its punishment, I will also visit the sanctuaries of Bethel; the altars of the sanctuary shall be broken, and they shall fall to the ground.
I will destroy the house of winter and the house of summer; and the houses adorned with ivory shall perish; and the great houses shall have an end,” saith the Lord God.

sections.title: The turning away of Israel from the Lord.

verses.text: O ye who dwell in the mountains of Samaria, who oppress the poor and crush the needy, who say unto your lords, "Bring and let us drink!" Hear this word.
Thus saith the Lord God, "Behold, the day cometh when I will send a famine upon the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the Lord."
"Your transgressions have been multiplied; you are entangled one with another; and upon the mountain of Remmon shall ye be cast down," saith the Lord God.

sections.title: The people of Israel shall not cease from error.

verses.text: “ወደ ቤቴል ገብታችሁ ኀጢአትን ሠራችሁ፤ በጌልገላም ኀጢአትን አበዛችሁ፤ በየማለዳውም መሥዋዕታችሁን፥ በየሦስተኛውም ቀን ዐሥራታችሁን አቀረባችሁ፤
ሕጉን በውጭ አነበባችሁ፤ የታመነም አላችሁት፤ በፈቃዳችሁም የምታቀርቡትን አውጁና አውሩ፥” ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።
“በከተማችሁ ሁሉ ጥርስን ማጥረስን፥ በስፍራችሁም ሁሉ እንጀራን ማጣትን ሰጠኋችሁ፤ እናንተ ግን ወደ እኔ አልተመለሳችሁም ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
መከር ሳይደርስ ገና ከሦስት ወር በፊት ዝናብን ከለከልኋችሁ፤ በአንድም ከተማ ላይ አዘነብሁ፤ በሌላውም ከተማ ላይ እንዳይዘንብ አደረግሁ፤ በአንድ ወገን ዘነበ፤ ያልዘነበበትም ወገን ደረቀ።
የሁለት ወይም የሦስት ከተሞች ሰዎች ወደ አንዲት ከተማ ውኃ ይጠጡ ዘንድ ሄዱ፤ ነገር ግን አልረኩም፤ እናንተ ግን ወደ እኔ አልተመለሳችሁም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
በአባርና በቸነፈር መታኋችሁ፤ አትክልታችሁ፥ ወይናችሁና በለሳችሁ፥ ወይራችሁም ከበጀ በኋላ ተምች በላው፤ ይህም ሆኖ እናንተ ወደ እኔ አልተመለሳችሁም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
“በግብፅ እንደ ሆነው ሞትን ሰደድሁባችሁ፤ ጐበዛዝቶቻችሁን በሰይፍ ገደልሁ፤ ፈረሶቻችሁንም አስማረክሁ፤ በሰፈራችሁም እሳትን ሰድጄ አጠፋኋችሁ፤ በዚህም ሁሉ እናንተ ወደ እኔ አልተመለሳችሁም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
ሰዶምንና ገሞራን አስቀድሜ እንደ ገለበጥኋቸው፥ እንዲሁ ገለበጥኋችሁ፤ እናንተም ከእሳት ውስጥ እንደ ተነጠቀ ትንታግ ሆናችሁ፤ በዚህም ወደ እኔ አልተመለሳችሁም” ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
“ስለዚህ እስራኤል ሆይ! እንደዚህ አደርግብሃለሁ፤ እስራኤልም ሆይ! እንደዚህ ስለማደርግብህ የአምላክህን ስም ለመጥራት ተዘጋጅ።
እነሆ ነጐድጓድን የሚያጸና፥ ነፋስንም የፈጠረ፥ የመሢሕን ነገር ለሰው የሚነግር፥ ንጋትን ጭጋግ የሚያደርግ፥ በምድርም ከፍታዎች ላይ የሚረግጥ፥ ስሙ ሁሉን የሚችል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እኔ ነኝ።”
የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ! በእናንተ ላይ ለሙሾ የማነሣውን ይህን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ።
የእስራኤል ድንግል ወደቀች፤ ከእንግዲህም ወዲህ አትነሣም፤ በምድርዋ ላይ ተጣለች፤ የሚያስነሣትም የለም።
ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ ይላልና፥ “ሺህ ከሚወጡባት ከተማ መቶ ይቀራሉ፤ መቶም ከሚወጡባት ከተማ ለእስራኤል ቤት ዐሥር ይቀራሉ።”
እግዚአብሔርም ለእስራኤል ቤት እንዲህ ይላልና፥ “እኔን ፈልጉ፤ በሕይወትም ትኖራላችሁ፤
ነገር ግን ጌልገላ ፈጽሞ ትማረካለችና፥ ቤቴልም እንዳልነበረች ትሆናለችና ቤቴልን አትፈልጉ፤ ወደ ጌልገላም አትሂዱ፤ ወደ ቤርሳቤህም አትለፉ።”
በዮሴፍ ቤት እሳት እንዳትቃጠል፥ እንዳትበላቸውም የእስራኤልንም ቤት እሳት የሚያጠፋላቸው እንዳያጡ እግዚአብሔርን ፈልጉ፤ በሕይወትም ትኖራላችሁ።
እግዚአብሔር ፍርድን በሰማይ ያደርጋል፤ ጽድቅንም በምድር ላይ ይመሠርታል።
ሁሉን የሚሠራና የሚያቅናና፥ ብርሃኑን ወደ መስዕ የሚመልሰው፥ ቀኑን እንደ ሌሊት የሚያጨልመው፥ የባሕሩንም ውኃ ጠርቶ በምድር ፊት የሚያፈስሰው ስሙ ሁሉን የሚችል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ነው።
በኀያላን ላይ ቅጥቃጤን፥ በአንባዎችም ላይ ጕስቍልናን ያመጣል።
በበሩ የሚገሥጸውን ጠሉ፤ እውነትንም የሚናገረውን ተጸየፉ።

For you have oppressed the poor, and you have taken away the covering from him; you have chosen the beautiful houses and have made them your servants; yet do not dwell in them; the pleasant places of wine have you made your own; yet do not drink the wine.
O you who afflict the righteous, and receive gifts, and pervert the judgment of the needy at the gate! How shall I not know your iniquities, and how shall I not see your sins?
Therefore, this generation is evil, and in that time, the wise shall keep silence.
Seek the good, that you may live; and do not do evil; thus shall the Lord God be with you, as you have spoken.
Hate the evil, and love the good; establish justice in the gate; perhaps the Lord God, who is able to do all things, will be gracious to Joseph.

Therefore, the Lord God, who is able to do all things, says this: “In every place of your gates, there shall be wailing; in every way, there shall be lamentation; and the farmers shall call to the harvest, and the gatherers shall call to the wailing.”
“I will rise in your midst, and in every street, there shall be lamentation,” says the Lord God.
የእግዚአብሔርን ቀን ለምትፈልጉ ወዮላችሁ! የእግዚአብሔርን ቀን ለምን ትፈልጋላችሁ? ጨለማ ነው እንጂ ብርሃን አይደለም።
ከአንበሳ ፊት እንደ ሸሸ፥ ድብም እንዳገኘው ሰው፥ ወደ ቤትም ገብቶ እጁን በግድግዳ ላይ እንዳስደገፈና እባብ እንደ ነደፈው ሰው ይሆናል።
የእግዚአብሔር ቀን ብርሃን ሳይሆን ጨለማ አይደለምን? ፀዳል የሌለውም ድቅድቅ ጨለማ አይደለምን?
ዓመት በዓላችሁን ጠልችዋለሁ፤ አርቄውማለሁ፤ መዓዛ መሥዋዕታችሁን አላሸትም።
የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕታችሁንና የእህሉን ቍርባናችሁን ብታቀርቡልኝም እንኳ አልቀበለውም፤ የድኅነት መሥዋዕታችሁንም አልመለከትም።
የዝማሬህንም ጩኸት ከእኔ ዘንድ አርቅ፤ የመሰንቆህንም ዜማ አላዳምጥም።
ነገር ግን ፍርድ እንደ ውኃ፥ ጽድቅም እንደማይደርቅ ፈሳሽ ይፍሰስ።
“የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ! በውኑ በምድረ በዳ አርባ ዓመት ሙሉ መሥዋዕትንና ቍርባንን አቅርባችሁልኛልን?
ለራሳችሁም የሠራችኋቸውን ምስሎች፥ የሞሎክን ድንኳንና የአምላካችሁን የሬፋንን ኮከብ አነሣችሁ።
ስለዚህ ከደማስቆ ወደዚያ አስማርካችኋለሁ” ይላል ስሙ የሠራዊት ጌታ የተባለ እግዚአብሔር።
ጽዮንን ለሚንቁ፥ በሰማርያም ተራራ ለሚታመኑ ሰዎች ወዮላቸው፤ የአሕዛብን አለቆች ለቀሙአቸው።
የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ ወደ ካልኔ ተሻግራችሁ ተመልከቱ፤ ከዚያም ወደ ኤማትራባ እለፉ፤ ከዚያም ወደ ፍልስጥኤም ጌት ውረዱ፤ እነርሱ ከእነዚህ መንግሥታት ይበረታሉ፤ ድንበራቸውም ከድንበራቸው ይሰፋልና።
ክፉ ቀንን ለሚፈልጓት፥ የሐሰት ሰንበታትን ለሚያቀራርቡና አንድ ለሚያደርጉ፥
ከዝሆን ጥርስ በተሠራ አልጋ ላይ ለሚተኙ፥ በምንጣፋቸው ደስ ለሚሰኙ፥ ከበጎችም መንጋ ጠቦትን፥ ከጋጥም ውስጥ ጥጃን ለሚመገቡ፥
ከበገናው ድምፅ ጋር አስተባብረው ለሚያጨበጭቡ ሰዎች፤ ይኸውም የማያልፍ ለሚመስላቸውና እንደሚያመልጣቸው ለማያውቁ፤
በጽዋ የቀላ ወይን ለሚጠጡ፥ እጅግ በአማረ ሽቱም ለሚቀቡ፥ በዮሴፍ ስብራት ለማያስቡ ወዮላቸው።
ስለዚህ ከአለቆቻቸው አስቀድመው ይማረካሉ፤ ሯጮች የሚሆኑ የኤፍሬም ፈረሶችም ያልቃሉ።
ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፥ “የያዕቆብን ትዕቢት አረክሳለሁ፤ ሀገሮቹንም ጠላሁ፤ ከተሞቹንም ከሚኖሩባቸው ሰዎች ጋር አጠፋለሁ” ብሎ በራሱ ምሎአልና።
እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ ዐሥር ሰዎች በአንድ ቤት ውስጥ ቢቀሩ እነርሱ ይሞታሉ፤ የቀሩት ግን ይተርፋሉ።
አጥንቶቻቸውንም ከቤት ያወጡ ዘንድ ቤተሰቦቻቸው በወሰዱአቸው ጊዜ፥ ቤት ጠባቂውን በአንተ ዘንድ የቀረ አለን? በአለው ጊዜ እርሱ የለም ይላል። ያም የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም እንዳትጠራ ዝም በል ይለዋል።
እነሆም እግዚአብሔር ያዝዛል፤ ታላቁንም ቤት በማፍረስ፥ ታናሹንም ቤት በመሰባበር ይመታል።
ፍርድን ወደ ቍጣ፥ የእውነትንም ፍሬ ወደ እሬት ለውጣችኋልና፥ በውኑ ፈረሶች በጭንጫ ላይ ይሮጣሉን? ወይስ በሬዎች በዚያ ላይ ያርሳሉን?
በከንቱ ነገር ደስ የሚላችሁ በኀይላችን ቀንዶችን አበቀልን የምትሉ አይደለምን?
“የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ እነሆ እኔ የሚያስጨንቋችሁን ሕዝብ አስነሣባችኋለሁ፥” ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ እግዚአብሔር፤ እነርሱም ከሐማት መግቢያ ጀምረው እስከ ዐረባ ወንዝ ድረስ ትገቡ ዘንድ አይፈቅዱላችሁም።
The Lord God showed me thus; Behold, a swarm of locusts shall come from the east; and one of them was Gog, the king of the locusts.
And it shall consume the grass of the land; and I said, "O Lord God! Forgive, I beseech Thee; for who shall lift up Jacob? For he is small."
And the Lord repented concerning this matter; and the Lord said, "It shall not be."
The Lord God showed me thus; behold, the Lord God called forth fire by His word for judgment; and it consumed the great deep and the earth beneath.
And I said, "O Lord God! I beseech You, who shall deliver Jacob? For he is but a small remnant."
And the Lord God responded concerning this matter; "This also shall not be," said the Lord God.

sections.title: The prophet beheld a vision concerning the tunic.

verses.text: The Lord God showed me this: Behold, a man stood upon a wall made of a plumb line; and in his hand was a plumb line.

And the Lord said unto me, "Amos, what seest thou?" And I said, "A plumb line." Then said the Lord, "Behold, I will set a plumb line in the midst of my people Israel; I will not again pass by them anymore."
The high places of Isaac shall be desolate, and the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword."
And Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, “Amos hath conspired against thee in the midst of the house of Israel; the land is not able to bear all his words.”
For Amos said, “Jeroboam shall die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of their own land.”
And Amaziah said unto Amos, “O thou seer, go, flee thee away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there.”
Yet Amaziah said, “But prophesy not again any more at Bethel; for it is the king's chapel, and it is the king's court.”
Then Amos answered and said to Amaziah, “I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet's son; but I was an herdman, and a gatherer of sycomore fruit.”
And the Lord took me as I followed the flock, and the Lord said unto me, ‘Go, prophesy unto my people Israel.’
Now therefore hear thou the word of the Lord: Thou sayest, ‘Prophesy not against Israel, and drop not thy word against the house of Isaac.’

Therefore thus saith the Lord; “Thy wife shall be an harlot in the city, and thy sons and thy daughters shall fall by the sword, and thy land shall be divided by line; and thou shalt die in a polluted land, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of his own land.”

sections.title: The fruit of the filled basket.

verses.text: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ አሳየኝ፤ እነሆም የቃርሚያ ፍሬ የሞላበት ዕንቅብ ነበረ።
እርሱም፥ “አሞጽ ሆይ! የምታየው ምንድን ነው?” አለኝ። እኔም፥ “የቃርሚያ ፍሬ የሞላበት ዕንቅብ ነው” አልሁት። እግዚአብሔርም አለኝ፥ “ፍጻሜ በሕዝቤ በእስራኤል ላይ መጥቶአል፤ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ደግሞ ይቅር አልላቸውም።
ያንጊዜም በመቅደሶቻቸው ዋይ ዋይ ይላሉ” ይላል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፤ በየስፍራው የሚወድቀው ሬሳ ይበዛልና፤ እነርሱም ይጠፋሉና።
"O you who oppress the needy in the morning, and who crush the poor of the land!"
"When shall we sell the grain, and when shall the sabbath pass, that we may set forth the measure of wheat, and may sell the ephah, and may deceive with false balances?"
"To buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals, and to sell the refuse of the wheat? Hear this, you who say!"
"The Lord hath sworn by the pride of Jacob, 'Surely I will never forget any of their works.'"
"Shall not the land tremble for this? And every one that dwelleth therein shall mourn? And it shall rise up wholly as a flood; and it shall be cast out and drowned, as by the flood of Egypt."
"And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord God, that the sun shall go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the clear day."

"And I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; and I will bring up sackcloth upon all loins, and baldness upon every head; and I will make it as the mourning of an only son, and the end thereof as a bitter day."
"Behold, the days come, saith the Lord God, that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the Lord."
"And they shall wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east; they shall run to and fro to seek the word of the Lord, and shall not find it."
"And in that day shall the fair virgins and young men faint for thirst."
"Dan, O you who are alive, your God! Furthermore, they say, 'The living God of your Bethel,' and they who are called by the name of Samaria shall fall; moreover, they shall not rise again."

sections.title: The judgment of the Lord upon Israel.

verses.text: እግዚአብሔርን በመሠውያው ላይ ቆሞ አየሁት፤ እርሱም እንዲህ አለኝ፥ “አበቦች የተሳሉባቸውን ምሰሶዎችን ምታ፤ መድረኮቹም ይናወጣሉ፤ ራሳቸውንም ቍረጥ፤ እኔም ከእነርሱ የቀሩትን በሰይፍ እገድላለሁ፤ ከሚሸሹትም የሚያመልጥ የለም፤ ከሚያመልጡትም የሚድን የለም።
ወደ ሲኦል ቢወርዱ እጄ ከዚያ ታወጣቸዋለች፤ ወደ ሰማይም ቢወጡ ከዚያ አወርዳቸዋለሁ፤
በቀርሜሎስ ራስ ውስጥ ቢሸሸጉ ፈልጌ ከዚያ አወጣቸዋለሁ፤ በባሕሩም ጥልቅ ውስጥ ከዐይኔ ቢደበቁ በዚያ እባቡን አዝዛለሁ፤ እርሱም ይነድፋቸዋል፤
በጠላቶቻቸውም ፊት ተማርከው ቢሄዱ በዚያ ሰይፍን አዝዛታለሁ፤ እርስዋም ትገድላቸዋለች፤ ዐይኔንም ለመልካም ሳይሆን ለክፋት በእነርሱ ላይ እጥላለሁ።”
ሁሉን የሚችል ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ምድርን ሁሉ ይዳስሳል፤ ያነዋውጣታልም፤ የሚኖሩባትም ሁሉ ያለቅሳሉ፤ ግድያ እንደ ወንዝ ይፈስሳል፤ ደግሞም እንደ ግብፅ ወንዝ ይወርዳል።
አዳራሹን በሰማይ የሠራ፥ ትእዛዙንም በምድር ላይ የመሠረተ፥ የባሕርንም ውኃ ጠርቶ በምድር ፊት የሚያፈስሰው እርሱ ነው፤ ስሙም ሁሉን የሚገዛ እግዚአብሔር ነው።
“የእስራኤል ልጆች ሆይ! እናንተ ለእኔ እንደ ኢትዮጵያ ልጆች አይደላችሁምን? ይላል እግዚአብሔር። እስራኤልን ከግብፅ ምድር፥ ፍልስጥኤማውያንንም ከቀጰዶቅያ፥ ሶርያውያንንም ከጕድጓድ ያወጣሁ አይደለምን?
እነሆ የጌታ የእግዚአብሔር ዐይኖች በኀጢአተኛ መንግሥት ላይ ናቸው፤ ከምድርም ፊት አጠፋታለሁ፤ ነገር ግን የያዕቆብን ቤት ፈጽሜ አላጠፋም፤ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
እነሆ አዝዛለሁ፤ እህልም በመንሽ እንደሚዘራ የእስራኤልን ቤት በአሕዛብ ሁሉ መካከል እዘራለሁ፤ ነገር ግን አንዲት ቅንጣት በምድር ላይ አትወድቅም።
ክፉው ነገር አይደርስብንም፤ አያገኘንምም የሚሉ የሕዝቤ ኀጢአተኞች ሁሉ በሰይፍ ይሞታሉ።
"On that day, I will raise up the fallen tent of David; I will repair its broken places and restore its ruins; and I will rebuild it as in the days of old."
"This is what the Lord says: 'I will seek out the remnant of My people, and all the nations that are called by My name.'"

"Behold, the Lord says, 'Will such a time come upon us? The field will be as one with the wilderness, and the seed will be as one with the thorns; the mountains will be covered with honey, and the valleys will be filled with thorns.'"

"I will restore the fortunes of My people Israel; they shall rebuild the cities that were destroyed and inhabit them; they shall plant vineyards and drink their wine; they shall make gardens and eat their fruit."
"And I will plant them in their land, and they shall never again be uprooted from the land that I have given them," says the Lord, who is able to do all things.
